name: BASICS Acrylic Paint Set, 12 x 22 ml
statusReason: Kept as a candidate only because affiliate tracking is on site-wide and the Associates Link Checker has not yet been run for this product. Once Cowork records affiliateLinkEligible yes, set status verified (or provisional) and editorialDecision approve.
bestUse: Best for mixing your own tints for small decorative clay pieces
descriptionOriginal: Twelve 22 ml tubes of medium-viscosity, satin-finish acrylic in primaries, earth tones, black and white.
whyWeLikeIt: With a proper white and a handful of strong colours you can mix your own blush, butter and sage, and the larger tubes keep going into later projects. A good pick if you enjoy mixing.
limitations: There are no ready-made pastels, so soft shades mean mixing from white. The finish is satin, not matte. The maker lists surfaces such as stone and ceramics but does not name air-dry clay, and its page counts the colours two ways (six in the text, twelve in the specifications), so check the box contents.
qualityNote: Customers like the colour variety and the blending; some say the amount of paint varies.
verificationSource: Cowork, owner's browser, 2026-11-19: PILOT-VERIFICATION-V2.csv in the old repository (branch cowork/editorial-tasks), decision keep, in stock, matches description. Seller was not re-read (earlier read said Amazon). Affiliate Link Checker not yet run.
specsEvidence: Liquitex product page https://www.liquitex.com/products/basics-acrylic-set-12x22ml (read 2026-11-20): 12 tubes of 22 ml, medium viscosity, satin finish, lists canvas, paper and board, wood, metal, stone and ceramics, textiles among its surfaces, AP certified. Does not mention clay.
suitability: Someone who likes to mix colours from a few tubes and does not mind a satin finish.
